BiosyntheticClassifierSuite — 10-Head 1D-CNN Enzyme Specificity & EM Self-Training

Factorized multi-scale 1D-CNN heads (embed_dim=16, num_filters=64, kernel_size=(5, 9, 13), spatial_zones=2) warm-started from [GeneRoleClassifier][serogen.genes.cnn.GeneRoleClassifier] and trained via 2-pass Expectation-Maximization across [GlycanRecords][kbank.db.GlycanRecords].

1. 10-Head 1D-CNN Cross-Validation & Homology-Cluster Pooling

Comparing 5-fold sequence-stratified cross-validation (Top-1 and Top-3) against single-ORF and MCL homology-cluster log-probability pooling (predict_cluster_proba).

2. 2-Pass Expectation-Maximization (EM) Bipartite Self-Training

Pass 1 fits all 10 CNN heads on initial PanGraphConsensusPrior alignments; the E-step re-aligns non-locked records using the neural sequence prior before Pass 2 refits the production suite.

Topological Linkage Split (Backbone / Branch / Wzy) 4,689 / 1,481 / 1,215 Supervises is_backbone and wzy_linkage arborescence cycle closure

4. Complete 10-Head Performance Breakdown

Factorizing (donor, linkage, acceptor_sugar, acceptor_motif, mechanism, is_backbone) allows rare donor-linkage combinations to be resolved compositionally even when unseen as a joint pair.
